cards.title: Ewer
cards.extract: Many sancai or "three-color" lead-glazed wares-such as this ewerare notable for their heavy dependence on metalwork prototypes. Such polychrome glazed wares were intended for the tomb.

cards.title: Golf clubhouse by Graham Baba nods to farm structures in rural Washington
cards.extract: US studio Graham Baba Architects used timber and board-formed concrete to create "warmth and depth" at the Westwood Golf clubhouse and driving range in an agricultural region. The project completed a refresh of the nine-hole golf course in the central Washington town of Yakima. cards.title: Sage Guangzhou Aranya Store / say architects
cards.extract: Rooted in Aranya Guangzhou's site DNA—"half urban bustle, half lake-and-mountain scenery"—and meeting Sage Studio's natural, relaxed lifestyle ethos, a new context takes shape. A lived-in sensibility reconciles the everyday with the poetic; directness runs through material and structure; playfulness threads scene and experience. Here, say builds for sage a small house made for holidays.
